PreToolUse._note: any Read of a /tool-results/ file is denied for main and sub-agents alike; the rest (image, re-read, whole big file) is main-session only

implementer*/scripter* sub-agents only, measured on the worker transcript <dir(transcript_path)>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<agent_id>.jsonl: warns once at 150000 tokens of context, denies every tool except Bash at 220000, and nudges once on the 3rd build/test/verifica-* Bash call; triggers logged in /tmp/claude-hooks/context-agent.jsonl

PostToolUse._note: main and every sub-agent: non-blocking signal when an Edit/Write adds a comment block of 2+ lines, a comment line over 160 chars, or over 25% comments in the added lines; logs to /tmp/claude-hooks/comentarii-<session>.jsonl
